finalChangedProjectTests.purpose: Rechecked after the final B30 enlargement

conceptualReview.basis: Authored vocabulary ranges per repeated ornamental unit; excludes the underlying lattice, palette and display fillets

limitations: Conceptual estimates are authored review hypotheses, not measured cognitive load or discovered substructures.
The broad eight-lobed flower is reused in several families; larger silhouettes do not establish equal ornamental diversity.
Palette, fillets, outline width and contour fill remain display interpretations.
Selected finite containment and neighbour checks do not establish general occupied-face, curvature-clearance, infinite-tiling or aesthetic laws.
